paragraphs.text: Multi-view for DeepSeek Harness: 2-4 live conversations side by side, each pane the real Chat.
# dsh-multiview — split view for DeepSeek Harness
> Two to four **real** conversations side by side in one window. Every pane is the shipped Chat: com
poser, streaming, tool cards, approval cards, `ask_user_question`, attachments, slash commands, stop

/queue.
>
> The goal is not "a working split view" — it is to read as a feature the app ships with:
no title-bar takeover, no layout hijacking, no monkey-patching of private extension points.
中文 | English
## Install
Install from npm with `dsh plugin add dsh-multiview`, or search for it under **Plugins → Add** in DS
H Desktop (a maintainer can also run `plugin_manager install_bundle`), then **quit and reopen** Deep
Seek Harness so the client bundle loads again.
A "Split" icon appears in the left panel list; click it to turn the central column into the stage, c
lick again to return to the native conversation.

- Requires DSH `>=0.2.1-rc.5 <0.2.2-0 || >=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0` (`engines.dsh`).
- Uninstall: disable/
remove on the Plugins page, restart. The only residue is the `localStorage['dsh.multiview.v1']` layo
ut key (the stage's "Reset" clears it).
## Using it
| Action | How |

| Open / close | The "Split" icon in the sidebar panel list |
| 2 / 3 / 4 panes | The `2` `3` `4` ch

ips in the stage bar |
| Resize | Drag the divider between panes |
| Swap two panes | Drag a pane **

title** onto another pane |
| Maximize / restore | The ⤢ button in the pane header; the stage bar sh

ows "Restore" |
| Bind an empty pane | Search and pick a session right inside the pane |
| Open in t
he native view | The ↗ button: hands the session back to the real conversation (the right sidebar's

file preview and diff review only exist there) |
| Remove a pane | The ✕ button; a bound pane goes *
*back to the session list** (the split keeps its shape), an empty pane is what ✕ actually removes |
| Views | Bar → Views: a split with 2+ sessions is remembered automatically; click to restore, ✕ to

delete |
| Check for updates | Refresh icon at the right of the bar: checked every 24h, red dot on a
new release, confirm to update |
Shortcuts (module defaults; rebind in **Settings → Shortcuts**):
| Command | Default (desktop) |

| Focus previous / next pane | `Mod+Alt+[` / `Mod+Alt+]` |
| Maximize or restore the focused pane |

`Mod+Alt+M` |
| Remove the focused pane from the split | `Mod+Alt+W` |
> The browser (Web) shell gets **no default bindings**: DSH's shortcut layer accepts a very narrow s
et of web/Linux combinations, and forcing one fails at boot with "reserved". Desktop defaults work;
bind them manually on Web.
## Not supported in v1 (on purpose)
1. **File preview / diff inside a pane** — whenever any global panel is active, DSH unmounts the rig
ht sidebar's session surface (`no session surface is mounted`; shipped panels behave the same). Use

↗ to work in the native view.
2. **Creating a session inside a pane** — the hero's workspace picker

is application-level navigation. Create sessions natively.
3. **Trajectory / plugin view switching p

er pane** — panes are pinned to Chat; no invented tabs.
4. **Sidebar click routed into the focused p
ane** — that needs interception of a private navigation path; sidebar clicks keep their native behav

iour (they leave the split).
5. Auto-sleep — resources are released when a pane is removed or reboun

d; there is no pretend "pause rendering of unfocused panes".
6. More than four panes.
## Performance
Measured with a CDP rAF sampler on `desktop-kfscv8c-1` (1530×851 window):
| Scenario | p50 | p95 | max | long tasks >50ms | JS heap |

| Native conversation (baseline) | 16.7ms | 16.7ms | 16.8ms | 0 | 43MB |
| Four panes mounted, idle

| 16.7ms | 16.8ms | 16.8ms | 0 | 75MB |
| Four panes, two streams at once | 16.7ms | 16.7ms | 16.8ms

| 0 | 85MB |
| Four panes, four long streams at once | 16.7ms | 50ms | 150ms | 2 | 53MB |
Four long streams is the heaviest case measured: still near 60fps on average, but p95 rises to 50ms
with an occasional 150ms frame (four virtualized transcripts re-laying out per chunk). v1 deliberate
ly does not throttle — "every pane stays a real Chat" wins over a frame number.
Transcripts are virtualized per turn by DSH itself, so a pane costs roughly one active turn plus one
editor instance. Below 900px wide or 520px tall the stage degrades to a single pane plus a pane swi
tcher; the layout tree is preserved.
## Development
No third-party dependencies; Node ≥ 22.18 (this repo uses 24.13).

The overlay's row name is an absolute `file:///` URL to this repo's `index.js` (the Loader anchors r
elative row names at the profile root, not beside the patch file).
The client only uses public slot surfaces: a keyed `main` panel, a private child slot, `SessionProvi
der`, the `conversation.content` factory (`variant:'embedded'`), `sessions.retain`, `shortcuts` and
`locale`. See docs/DESIGN.md.
## Status and support
Pre-1.0: the surface is stable enough to use daily, but small breaking changes can happen in a minor

bump, and every one of them is listed in CHANGELOG.md. Versions are published from a
tag by CI with
npm provenance, so what npm serves is exactly what this repository built.
The only network requests the client makes are the plugin market's same-origin API and, for version

discovery only, a public read of `registry.npmjs.org/dsh-multiview/latest` (no credentials, no
refer
rer). Installs still go through the market. `scripts/check.mjs` enforces that list.

`engines.dsh` accepts the whole `0.2.x` line. Builds are verified against `0.2.1-rc.5` and
`0.2.2-rc
.1`; on any other version the toolbar tooltip says so instead of pretending it was tested.
- Bugs and feature requests: issues (templates ask for the two things that matter — plugin version a

nd host version).
- Multi-pane rendering cost: filed upstream as discussion #12559.
- Anything that
is not split-view specific (sessions, permissions, providers) belongs to the harness project.
